The repository already defines the full compound 育成赛马娘 / 育成ウマ娘 as the player-facing Trainee concept and explicitly excludes it from generic Umamusume matching. Extend that same full-compound identity to text_data descriptions. This does not map bare 育成 or bare 赛马娘 and therefore avoids the ambiguity that required the original localize_dict key scoping.
